description: This file defines components for exporting and previewing chat messages in various formats (text, image, JSON), including modals, image previews, Markdown and JSON previews, and export controls. It is a key UI component related to exporting chat content in the NextChat project.

classes.name: useSteps
classes.description: Custom hook managing multi-step UI flow for exporting options.

classes.name: Steps
classes.description: Component rendering step indicators and progress bar.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Generates preview content based on selected format.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads the current preview as an image or file.

methods.name: refreshPreview
methods.description: Refreshes the image preview by re-rendering.
